jtbd.jtbd_title: Submission tracker + asset hygiene for Oct window
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Harden the action register (owners/dues), complete evidence links, schedule recommender follow-ups, and grow a short-answer bank aligned to essay work.

interactions.user_ask: I’m losing track of evidence links across essays.
interactions.jenny_reply: Add a 4-column table: Prompt | Proof artifact | Link | Status. Ten-minute hygiene daily—fill one gap.

interactions.user_ask: Recommenders haven’t answered; what do I send?
interactions.jenny_reply: 3-liner follow-up: gratitude → specific ask → two times + file link. Time-box to 24h rebump.
Use image→verb→why-now. Bank twelve 100–250c micro-snippets before final polish.

interactions.user_ask: Version chaos between parent/AI edits and mine.
interactions.jenny_reply: One source of truth: CA master doc + change-log. Freeze windows before cross-app propagation.
R/A/G calendarization: Red ≤3 days, Amber ≤7, Green >7. Weekly: move Amber→Green first.

interactions.user_ask: What are the two ships this week?
interactions.jenny_reply: 1 draft→final + 1 proof artifact (clip, link, or screenshot). Choose smallest next proof.
